The build succeeds. The change is complete.

I made two edits to `rust/src/server/src/routes.rs`:

1. Imported `axum::extract::DefaultBodyLimit`.
2. Applied `.layer(DefaultBodyLimit::max(32 * 1024 * 1024))` to the router right after `.with_state(...)`, so all routes — including `POST /v1/chat/completions` — accept bodies up to 32 MiB, overriding Axum's default 2 MiB limit.

Since the layer is applied to the fully-composed router (all routes are added before the layers), it covers every endpoint uniformly.
